import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
p, m, k = 5, 9, 3

C = rng.standard_normal((p, m))
Omega = rng.standard_normal((m, k))

import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(91)
n, r = 6, 2
L = np.eye(n) + 0.1 * np.tril(rng.standard_normal((n, n)))
T = L @ L.T
D = L @ np.diag([5., 5., 1., 1., -2., -2.]) @ L.T
jets = []
for _ in range(6):
    X = 0.2 * rng.standard_normal((n, n))
    jets.append(X + X.T)
D_s, T_s, D_t, T_t, D_st, T_st = jets
assert np.allclose(mixed_generalized_projector_derivative(D, T, D_s, T_s, D_t, T_t, D_st, T_st, r), target)
